newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument to redeem notes.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument to redeem notes.

text.p: General Instrument Corp said Thursday it will redeem on July 21 its outstanding five percent convertible junior subordinated notes due June 15, 2000, totaling $228 million.
Noteholders can convert their notes until July 18 at 42.1 shares of GIC common stock for each $1,000 principal amount of notes.
Holders who choose to redeem the notes will get the redemption price of 102.143 percent plus accrued interest through the redemption date, the company said.
GIC is redeeming the notes in preparation for its separation into three public companies -- NextLevel Systems, CommScope and General Semiconductor -- this summer.

NextLevel is a supplier of systems and components for networks delivering video, voice and Internet/data services. CommScope is the world's largest maker of coaxial cable and a supplier of high-performance electronic cables. General Semiconductor handles sales of discrete semiconductors.
